prompt.en: Where today did you do something for the result rather than for the thing itself?
prompt.hi: आज आपने कौन-सा कार्य उसके फल के लिए किया, स्वयं कार्य के लिए नहीं?

prompt.en: What did you do today that nobody noticed? Did that change how you did it?
prompt.hi: आज आपने ऐसा क्या किया जिसे किसी ने नहीं देखा? क्या इससे आपके करने का ढंग बदला?

prompt.en: Was there something today that was not yours to do, and you did it anyway?
prompt.hi: आज कोई ऐसा कार्य था जो आपका नहीं था, फिर भी आपने किया?

prompt.en: What did you begin again today after having let it lapse?
prompt.hi: आज आपने कौन-सा छूटा हुआ कार्य फिर से आरंभ किया?

prompt.en: When did anger rise today, and what did it want you to do?
prompt.hi: आज क्रोध कब उठा, और वह आपसे क्या करवाना चाहता था?

prompt.en: What did you not say today that you wanted to say?
prompt.hi: आज आपने क्या नहीं कहा जो कहना चाहते थे?

prompt.en: What pulled at your attention today, and did you follow it?
prompt.hi: आज किस वस्तु ने आपका ध्यान खींचा, और क्या आप उसके पीछे गए?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Katha Upanishad 1.3.3-1.3.4

prompt.en: Name one small thing you kept to today, even though no one would have known.
prompt.hi: एक छोटी बात बताइए जिसका आपने आज पालन किया, यद्यपि किसी को पता न चलता।

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Yoga Sutras 2.32

prompt.en: What came to you today that you did nothing to earn?
prompt.hi: आज आपको क्या मिला जिसके लिए आपने कुछ नहीं किया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Taittiriya Upanishad 3.10

prompt.en: Think of one thing you used today. Whose work made it possible?
prompt.hi: आज आपने जो एक वस्तु प्रयोग की, उसके पीछे किसका श्रम था?

prompt.en: What did you eat today, and did you notice it while you ate?
prompt.hi: आज आपने क्या खाया, और क्या खाते समय आपका ध्यान उस पर था?

prompt.en: What did you do for someone today with no expectation of return?
prompt.hi: आज आपने किसी के लिए क्या किया जिसमें बदले की कोई अपेक्षा नहीं थी?

prompt.en: Was there someone today who needed something you could have given?
prompt.hi: आज क्या कोई ऐसा था जिसे कुछ चाहिए था और आप दे सकते थे?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva

prompt.en: Whose burden did you make lighter today, even slightly?
prompt.hi: आज आपने किसका भार थोड़ा भी हल्का किया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Vana Parva

prompt.en: What frightened you today? Was it the thing itself, or losing something?
prompt.hi: आज आपको किससे भय हुआ? वस्तु से, या कुछ खो जाने से?

prompt.en: What stayed steady in you today while things around you did not?
prompt.hi: आज जब चारों ओर सब बदल रहा था, आपमें क्या स्थिर रहा?

prompt.en: Where did you act today without knowing how it would turn out?
prompt.hi: आज आपने कहाँ बिना परिणाम जाने कदम उठाया?

prompt.en: Did telling the truth cost you anything today?
prompt.hi: क्या आज सत्य बोलने से आपको कुछ खोना पड़ा?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva

prompt.en: What did you say today that was true but not the whole of it?
prompt.hi: आज आपने क्या कहा जो सत्य था पर पूरा सत्य नहीं?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Karna Parva

prompt.en: Where did your mind go today when you were not watching it?
prompt.hi: आज जब आपका ध्यान नहीं था, तब मन कहाँ गया?

prompt.en: Did you sit still at any point today? What happened when you did?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आप कभी शांत बैठे? तब क्या हुआ?

prompt.en: Something went well today and something did not. Did you meet them differently?
prompt.hi: आज कुछ अच्छा हुआ और कुछ नहीं। क्या आपने दोनों को अलग-अलग लिया?

prompt.en: In whom did you recognise something of yourself today?
prompt.hi: आज आपने किसमें अपना ही कुछ अंश पहचाना?

prompt.en: Whom did you judge quickly today, and what might you not have known?
prompt.hi: आज आपने किसके विषय में शीघ्र निर्णय लिया, और क्या हो सकता है जो आप नहीं जानते थे?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva

prompt.en: Did anyone show you kindness today that you had not asked for?
prompt.hi: आज क्या किसी ने बिना माँगे आप पर करुणा की?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Brihadaranyaka Upanishad 5.2

prompt.en: What are you still carrying from earlier today that you could set down?
prompt.hi: आज के आरंभ का क्या भार अब भी आप उठाए हैं, जिसे रख सकते हैं?

prompt.en: What did you want to hold on to today that changed anyway?
prompt.hi: आज आप किसे थामे रखना चाहते थे जो फिर भी बदल गया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Katha Upanishad 1.1.26

prompt.en: If today were the whole of it, would you have spent it differently?
prompt.hi: यदि आज ही सब कुछ होता, तो क्या आप इसे भिन्न रूप से बिताते?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Katha Upanishad 1.1.21

prompt.en: Was there a moment today you mourned something that was never really lost?
prompt.hi: आज कोई ऐसा क्षण था जब आपने ऐसी वस्तु का शोक किया जो वास्तव में खोई ही नहीं थी?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 2.11 ("Thou grievest where no grief should be! thou speak'st words lacking wisdom")

prompt.en: What in you stayed the same today, underneath everything that changed on the surface?
prompt.hi: आज सतह पर जो कुछ बदला, उसके नीचे आपमें क्या वैसा ही रहा?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 2.20 ("Never the spirit was born; the spirit shall cease to be never; never was time it was not")

prompt.en: Trace one moment of irritation back to its start today. What did you want that you didn't get?
prompt.hi: आज की किसी झुंझलाहट को उसके आरंभ तक खोजिए। आप क्या चाहते थे जो नहीं मिला?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 3.37 ("Kama it is! Passion it is! ...man's enemy!")

prompt.en: Where today did you stay busy rather than sit with something uncomfortable?
prompt.hi: आज आप किसी असहज बात के साथ बैठने के बजाय व्यस्त कहाँ रहे?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 3.16 ("He that abstains to help the rolling wheels of this great world, glutting his idle sense, lives a lost life, shameful and vain")

prompt.en: Was there a task today that looked like rest but wasn't, or rest that looked like a task but was actually needed?
prompt.hi: आज कोई कार्य विश्राम-सा दिखा पर था नहीं, या कोई विश्राम कार्य-सा दिखा पर वास्तव में आवश्यक था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 4.18 ("He who sees how action may be rest, rest action -- he is wisest 'mid his kind")

prompt.en: Was there a decision today you kept putting off? What was the doubt actually costing you while you waited?
prompt.hi: आज कोई निर्णय था जिसे आप टालते रहे? प्रतीक्षा के दौरान संदेह आपसे वास्तव में क्या ले रहा था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 4.40 ("Those without full faith, and those who fear are shent; no peace is here or other where")

prompt.en: What did you understand today that changed how you saw something you'd done before?
prompt.hi: आज आपने ऐसा क्या समझा जिससे पहले किए किसी कार्य को देखने का ढंग बदल गया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 4.37-4.38 ("So unto ash, Arjuna! unto nought the flame of Knowledge wastes works' dross away! There is no purifier like thereto")

prompt.en: Whom did you treat as beneath you today, even slightly, without noticing you were doing it?
prompt.hi: आज आपने किसे, बिना ध्यान दिए भी, अपने से नीचे मानकर व्यवहार किया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 5.18 ("The Brahman with his scrolls and sanctities, the cow, the elephant, the unclean dog, the Outcast gorging dog's meat, are all one")

prompt.en: Today, were you more your own friend or your own enemy?
prompt.hi: आज आप अपने अधिक मित्र थे या अपने ही शत्रु?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 6.5-6.6 ("Soul is Self's friend when Self doth rule o'er Self, but Self turns enemy if Soul's own self hates Self as not itself")

prompt.en: Where today did you push too hard or slack off too much, instead of finding the moderate path?
prompt.hi: आज आपने कहाँ अत्यधिक प्रयास किया या अत्यधिक ढील दी, बीच का मार्ग नहीं अपनाया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 6.16-6.17 ("Religion is not his who too much fasts or too much feasts...the true piety which most removes earth-aches and ills, where one is moderate in eating and in resting, and in sport")

prompt.en: What made you turn toward something larger than yourself today -- distress, curiosity, want, or simply because it was right?
prompt.hi: आज आपको अपने से बड़ी किसी बात की ओर किसने मोड़ा — कष्ट, जिज्ञासा, इच्छा, या केवल इसलिए कि यह उचित था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 7.16 ("Four sorts of mortals know me: he who weeps...and the man who yearns to know; and he who toils to help; and he who sits certain of me, enlightened")

prompt.en: Did anyone leave your presence today more unsettled than they arrived? Did you leave theirs that way?
prompt.hi: आज कोई आपके पास से पहले से अधिक अशांत होकर गया? क्या आप किसी के पास से वैसे ही गए?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 12.15 ("Who troubleth not his kind, and is not troubled by them; clear of wrath, living too high for gladness, grief, or fear")

prompt.en: Did today's praise or criticism actually change anything about who you are?
prompt.hi: आज की प्रशंसा या आलोचना ने वास्तव में आपके होने में कुछ बदला?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 12.18-12.19 ("Takes heat and cold, pleasure and pain; abides quit of desires, hears praise or calumny in passionless restraint")

prompt.en: Where today did you want credit or recognition for something, even quietly?
prompt.hi: आज आपने किसी बात के लिए, चुपचाप ही सही, श्रेय या पहचान चाही?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 13.7-13.11 ("Humbleness, truthfulness, and harmlessness, patience and honour, reverence for the wise")

prompt.en: Was there greed, restlessness, or craving in you today? What set it moving?
prompt.hi: आज आपमें लोभ, बेचैनी या लालसा थी? उसे किसने जगाया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 14.12 (signs of rajas increasing: greed, exertion for gain, restlessness, craving)

prompt.en: Could you watch your own mood today rise and fall without being carried off by either?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आप अपने ही मनोभाव को उठते-गिरते देख सके, बिना उसमें बह गए?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 14.22-14.23 ("He who with equanimity surveys lustre of goodness, strife of passion, sloth of ignorance, not angry if they are, not wishful when they are not")

prompt.en: Which of the three -- wanting, resenting, or hoarding -- had the strongest hold on you today?
prompt.hi: इच्छा, द्वेष और संचय — आज इनमें से किसकी पकड़ आप पर सबसे प्रबल थी?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 16.21 ("The Doors of Hell are threefold, whereby men to ruin pass -- the door of Lust, the door of Wrath, the door of Avarice")

prompt.en: Where were you fearless today, and where did fear quietly steer you instead?
prompt.hi: आज आप कहाँ निर्भय थे, और कहाँ भय ने चुपचाप आपकी दिशा तय की?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 16.1-16.3 ("Fearlessness, singleness of soul, the will always to strive for wisdom")

prompt.en: Did you help anyone today while quietly counting on something back?
prompt.hi: आज आपने किसी की सहायता की, पर मन ही मन कुछ बदले की आशा रखी?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 17.21 (gifts given expecting reciprocation, or reluctantly, are of the passionate kind)

prompt.en: Did you give something today -- time, help, attention -- in a way that made the person feel small for needing it?
prompt.hi: आज आपने कुछ दिया — समय, सहायता, ध्यान — पर क्या इस ढंग से कि लेने वाला स्वयं को छोटा महसूस करे?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 17.22 ("that charity which is given at the wrong place and wrong time to unworthy persons, without showing respect, or with contempt, is held to be of the nature of nescience")

prompt.en: Was there something today that felt unpleasant while you did it, but that you're glad afterward you did?
prompt.hi: आज कोई काम करते समय अप्रिय लगा, पर करने के बाद आपको संतोष हुआ?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 18.37-18.38 ("Bitter at first as poison to the soul, but afterward sweet as the taste of Amrit...it springeth in the Spirit's deep content" versus "Sweet as Amrit is its first taste, but its last bitter as poison")

prompt.en: Think of one thing you accomplished today. How much of it was actually you alone?
prompt.hi: आज जो एक कार्य आपने सिद्ध किया, उसमें वास्तव में कितना केवल आपका था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 18.13-18.14 (the five causes behind every act: the body, the doer, the senses, the effort, and providence)

prompt.en: Did you give something small today with real attention, rather than something large without any?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आपने कोई छोटी वस्तु पूरे ध्यान से दी, बजाय बड़ी वस्तु के बिना किसी ध्यान के?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 9.26 ("Whoso shall offer Me in faith and love a leaf, a flower, a fruit, water poured forth, that offering I accept, lovingly made with pious will")

prompt.en: Did you write anyone off today, in your own mind, as too far gone to change?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आपने मन ही मन किसी को इतना बिगड़ा हुआ मान लिया कि वह बदल ही नहीं सकता?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 9.30 ("If one of evil life turn in his thought straightly to Me, count him amidst the good; he hath the high way chosen; he shall grow righteous ere long")

prompt.en: Did you want something today that was someone else's, even briefly?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आपने किसी और की कोई वस्तु चाही, भले ही क्षण भर के लिए?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Isha Upanishad 1 ("When thou hast surrendered all this, then thou mayest enjoy. Do not covet the wealth of any man!")

prompt.en: In whom today did you see, even briefly, something that was really just yourself looking back?
prompt.hi: आज किसमें आपने, क्षण भर के लिए ही सही, कुछ ऐसा देखा जो वास्तव में आपका ही प्रतिबिंब था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Isha Upanishad 6 ("He who beholds all beings in the Self, and the Self in all beings, he never turns away from it")

prompt.en: Was there a grief or worry today that felt smaller once you stopped seeing yourself as separate from what caused it?
prompt.hi: आज कोई शोक या चिंता थी जो छोटी लगी जब आपने स्वयं को उसके कारण से अलग मानना छोड़ दिया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Isha Upanishad 7 ("When to the knower, all beings become one with his own Self, what perplexity, what grief, is there when he sees this oneness")

prompt.en: Today, were you more the bird eating the fruit, or the bird just watching?
prompt.hi: आज आप फल खाने वाले पक्षी अधिक थे, या केवल देखने वाले?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Mundaka Upanishad 3.1.1 ("Two birds, inseparable friends, cling to the same tree. One of them eats the sweet fruit, the other looks on without eating")

prompt.en: Was there a moment today you stepped back from something you were caught up in, and it looked completely different from outside?
prompt.hi: आज कोई क्षण था जब आप किसी उलझन से पीछे हटे, और बाहर से वह पूर्णतः भिन्न दिखी?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Mundaka Upanishad 3.1.2 ("On the same tree man sits grieving, immersed, bewildered by his own impotence. But when he sees the other lord contented and knows his glory, then his grief passes away")

prompt.en: What did you speak today without deciding to speak it -- where did the words actually come from?
prompt.hi: आज आपने क्या बिना निर्णय लिए बोला — वे शब्द वास्तव में कहाँ से आए?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Kena Upanishad 1.1-1.2 ("At whose wish does the mind sent forth proceed on its errand?...At whose wish do we utter this speech?")

prompt.en: Where today did you take the easier path when you knew the harder one was actually right?
prompt.hi: आज आपने कहाँ आसान मार्ग चुना, जबकि जानते थे कि कठिन मार्ग ही सही था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Katha Upanishad 1.3.14 ("The sharp edge of a razor is difficult to pass over; thus the wise say the path is hard")

prompt.en: Today, when the good and the pleasant pointed different ways, which one did you actually follow?
prompt.hi: आज जब भला और सुखद अलग दिशाओं में थे, आपने वास्तव में किसका अनुसरण किया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Katha Upanishad 1.2.1-1.2.2 ("The good is one thing, the pleasant another...the wise prefers the good to the pleasant, but the fool chooses the pleasant through greed")

prompt.en: What today was present in everything you did, even though you couldn't point to it directly?
prompt.hi: आज ऐसा क्या था जो आपके हर कार्य में मौजूद रहा, फिर भी आप उसे सीधे इंगित नहीं कर सकते?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Chandogya Upanishad 6.13 (a lump of salt dissolved in water cannot be seen, but the water tastes salty throughout -- "that which is the subtle essence, in it all that exists has its self")

prompt.en: Was there a moment today you saw yourself in someone you'd normally think of as completely unlike you?
prompt.hi: आज कोई क्षण था जब आपने किसी में स्वयं को देखा, जिसे आप सामान्यतः अपने से बिल्कुल भिन्न मानते हैं?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Chandogya Upanishad 6.8.7 ("Tat tvam asi" -- "That art thou")

prompt.en: Did you meet anger today with forgiveness, or with more anger?
prompt.hi: आज आपने क्रोध का सामना क्षमा से किया, या और अधिक क्रोध से?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXIX ("Anger must be conquered by forgiveness")

prompt.en: Where today would honesty have served you better than the shortcut you actually took?
prompt.hi: आज कहाँ ईमानदारी आपके लिए उस शॉर्टकट से बेहतर होती जो आपने वास्तव में अपनाया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXIX ("the wicked must be conquered by honesty")

prompt.en: Was there a moment today you held something back that you could have given freely?
prompt.hi: आज कोई क्षण था जब आपने कुछ रोक लिया जो सहजता से दे सकते थे?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXIX ("the miser must be conquered by liberality")

prompt.en: Who today was helpless or without power to answer you back -- and how did you treat them?
prompt.hi: आज कौन असहाय था या उत्तर देने में असमर्थ — और आपने उनके साथ कैसा व्यवहार किया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXVIII ("One should, with an effort, control his wrath against the gods, kings, Brahmanas, old men, children, and those that are helpless")

prompt.en: Whose experience or knowledge did you dismiss too quickly today?
prompt.hi: आज आपने किसके अनुभव या ज्ञान को बहुत जल्दी नकार दिया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXVIII ("The fool always disregardeth those that are elderly in years, and eminent in conduct and knowledge")

prompt.en: Did someone say something unkind to you today? What did staying silent cost you, or save you?
prompt.hi: आज किसी ने आपसे कुछ अप्रिय कहा? मौन रहने से आपने क्या खोया, या क्या बचाया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXVI ("the pain that is felt by him who beareth silently, consumeth the slanderer")

prompt.en: Did any words you said today do more damage than you meant them to?
prompt.hi: आज आपके कहे किन्हीं शब्दों ने आपकी सोच से अधिक हानि पहुँचाई?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXVI ("Harsh words burn and scorch the very vitals, bones, heart, and the very sources of the life of men")

prompt.en: Who did you spend the most time with today, and what of them is starting to rub off on you?
prompt.hi: आज आपने सबसे अधिक समय किसके साथ बिताया, और उनका क्या असर आप पर पड़ने लगा है?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXVI ("He that waiteth upon one that is good or upon one that is wicked...soon taketh the colour from that companion")

prompt.en: What today pulled at you -- anger, pride, vanity, or something else -- and did it manage to pull you off course?
prompt.hi: आज आपको क्रोध, अहंकार, दंभ, या किसी अन्य भाव ने खींचा — और क्या वह आपको मार्ग से भटका पाया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXIII ("He whom neither anger nor joy, nor pride, nor false modesty, nor stupefaction, nor vanity, can draw away from the high ends of life, is considered as wise")

prompt.en: Did you praise yourself today, even quietly, at someone else's expense?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आपने चुपचाप ही सही, किसी और की कीमत पर स्वयं की प्रशंसा की?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXIII ("That man who never assumeth a haughty mien, who never censureth others praising himself the while...is ever loved by all")

prompt.en: Before you acted today, did you actually stop to think about whether you were the right person for it, and why?
prompt.hi: आज कार्य करने से पहले, क्या आपने वास्तव में यह सोचा कि क्या आप उसके लिए उपयुक्त हैं, और क्यों?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXIV ("Before one engageth in an act, one should consider the competence of the agent, the nature of the act itself, and its purpose")

prompt.en: Did any words spoken to you today leave a mark that a wound to the body wouldn't have?
prompt.hi: आज किसी के कहे शब्दों ने ऐसा घाव छोड़ा जो शारीरिक घाव न छोड़ता?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXIV ("A forest pierced by arrows...may again grow, but one's heart wounded and censured by ill-spoken words never recovereth")

prompt.en: Did today's small compromise make tomorrow's bigger one easier to make?
prompt.hi: क्या आज के छोटे समझौते ने कल के बड़े समझौते को आसान बना दिया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXV ("Sin, repeatedly perpetrated, destroyeth intelligence; and the man who hath lost intelligence, repeatedly committeth sin")

prompt.en: Did you do anything today with tomorrow's you in mind, rather than just today's?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आपने कुछ ऐसा किया जो केवल आज के लिए नहीं, कल के आप को ध्यान में रखकर था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXV ("Do that during the day which may enable thee to pass the night in happiness")

prompt.en: Of pride, talking too much, eating too much, anger, craving, and picking fights -- which one showed up in you today?
prompt.hi: अहंकार, अधिक बोलना, अधिक खाना, क्रोध, लालसा, और कलह — आज इनमें से कौन आपमें दिखा?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXVII ("Excess of pride, excess in speech, excess in eating, anger, the desire of enjoyment, and intestine dissensions -- these...are six sharp swords that cut off the period of life")

prompt.en: Did anyone tell you something today that was hard to hear but true? How did you receive it?
prompt.hi: आज किसी ने आपसे कुछ ऐसा कहा जो सुनने में कठिन पर सत्य था? आपने उसे कैसे लिया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXVII ("The speaker, however, is rare, as also the hearer, of words that are disagreeable but medicinal")

prompt.en: Was there a moment today you were tempted to cut a corner out of fear or desire? Did you?
prompt.hi: आज कोई क्षण था जब भय या इच्छा से आप कोई शॉर्टकट लेना चाहते थे? क्या आपने लिया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XL ("Virtue should never be forsaken from desire, fear, or temptation, nay, nor for the sake of life itself")

prompt.en: What today was actually just pleasure or pain passing through, that you treated as though it would last?
prompt.hi: आज ऐसा क्या था जो वास्तव में केवल क्षणिक सुख या दुख था, पर आपने उसे स्थायी मानकर लिया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XL ("Virtue is everlasting; pleasure and pain are transitory...let contentment be thine, for contentment is the highest of all acquisitions")

prompt.en: Think of someone happy, someone suffering, someone doing well, and someone acting badly today. Did you meet each of them differently, or with the same reaction?
prompt.hi: आज किसी सुखी, किसी दुखी, किसी अच्छे कार्य करने वाले और किसी बुरे कार्य करने वाले को सोचिए। क्या आपने हर एक से भिन्न भाव से मिले, या एक ही भाव से?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Yoga Sutras 1.33 ("Friendship, mercy, gladness, and indifference, being thought of in regard to subjects, happy, unhappy, good, and evil respectively, pacify the Chitta")

prompt.en: What did you practice today, and were you attached to how it turned out?
prompt.hi: आज आपने क्या अभ्यास किया, और क्या आप उसके परिणाम से आसक्त थे?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Yoga Sutras 1.12 ("their control is by practice and non-attachment")

prompt.en: Has anything you've kept up for a long time started to feel steady, the way it didn't at first?
prompt.hi: क्या कोई ऐसी बात जिसे आप लंबे समय से निभा रहे हैं, अब स्थिर लगने लगी है, जैसी वह आरंभ में नहीं थी?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Yoga Sutras 1.14 ("this is firmly rooted, being well-attended to for a long time without interruption and with devotion")

prompt.en: Trace one difficult feeling from today back through its cause -- attachment, aversion, or a mistaken sense of self?
prompt.hi: आज की किसी कठिन भावना को उसके कारण तक खोजिए — आसक्ति, विद्वेष, या स्वयं की भ्रांत धारणा?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Yoga Sutras 2.3 ("The pain-bearing obstructions are ignorance, egoism, attachment, aversion, and clinging to life")

prompt.en: Which desire, if it simply stopped occupying your mind, would change the most about how you live?
prompt.hi: यदि कोई एक इच्छा आपके मन में स्थान बनाना छोड़ दे, तो आपके जीने के ढंग में सबसे अधिक क्या बदलेगा?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Brihadaranyaka Upanishad 4.4.7 ("When all the desires that dwell in his heart are gone, then he, having been mortal, becomes immortal")

prompt.en: What inquiry or question, followed all the way through today, left you less afraid than when you started?
prompt.hi: आज किस जिज्ञासा या प्रश्न को अंत तक खोजने से आपका भय आरंभ से कम हुआ?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Brihadaranyaka Upanishad 4.2.4 (Yajnavalkya to Janaka: "Fearlessness is Brahman, and you have reached that fearless abode of Brahman" -- attained through enquiries, studies, contemplations, and searches)

prompt.en: What roles did you carry today -- parent, worker, friend, rival -- and how much of you actually stayed the same underneath all of them?
prompt.hi: आज आपने कौन-कौन सी भूमिकाएँ निभाईं — माता-पिता, कर्मचारी, मित्र, प्रतिद्वंद्वी — और उन सबके नीचे वास्तव में कितना आप वैसे ही रहे?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Prasna Upanishad 6.5 ("As these flowing rivers that go towards the ocean, when they have reached the ocean, sink into it, their name and form are broken, and people speak of the ocean only")

prompt.en: Was there a moment today you consciously pulled your attention back from something, the way a tortoise draws in its limbs?
prompt.hi: आज कोई क्षण था जब आपने जान-बूझकर अपना ध्यान किसी वस्तु से हटा लिया, जैसे कछुआ अपने अंग समेट लेता है?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 2.58 ("When, like the tortoise that withdraws its limbs from all sides, he withdraws his senses from the sense objects, then his wisdom becomes steady")

prompt.en: What in you changed today, and what, underneath the change, stayed exactly what it was?
prompt.hi: आज आपमें क्या बदला, और परिवर्तन के नीचे क्या ठीक वैसा ही रहा?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 15.16 ("Being is twofold: the Divided, one; the Undivided, one. All things that live are 'the Divided'")

prompt.en: Was there something today you started and then let sit unfinished, and what did you do instead?
prompt.hi: आज कोई ऐसा कार्य था जिसे आपने आरंभ कर अधूरा छोड़ दिया, और उसके बदले क्या किया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXIII ("He that strives, having commenced anything, till it is completed, who never wasteth his time, and who hath his soul under control, is regarded wise")

prompt.en: Did you spend today's worry on something you actually have no power to change?
prompt.hi: क्या आज आपने अपनी चिंता उस बात पर खर्च की जिसे बदलने की शक्ति आपके पास वास्तव में नहीं?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XXXIII ("They that do not strive for objects that are unattainable, that do not grieve for what is lost and gone...are regarded to possess intellects endued with wisdom")

prompt.en: What did you not know about yourself today that would have changed how you acted, had you known it?
prompt.hi: आज आपने स्वयं के बारे में क्या नहीं जाना, जो जानने पर आपके कार्य करने का ढंग बदल देता?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XLII, Sanatsujatiya ("I say that ignorance is Death, and so the absence of ignorance is immortality")

prompt.en: Which came first today, a wanting, or the irritation that followed it?
prompt.hi: आज पहले क्या आया — कोई इच्छा, या उसके पीछे आई झुंझलाहट?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XLII, Sanatsujatiya ("The desire of enjoyments first killeth men. Lust and wrath soon follow behind it")

prompt.en: Did you know something today, or had you only read or heard about it?
prompt.hi: आज आपने वास्तव में कुछ जाना, या केवल उसके बारे में पढ़ा या सुना था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XLIII, Sanatsujatiya ("A Brahmana who without knowledge and asceticism hath only read much should only be known as a great reader")

prompt.en: Who taught you something today, and did you show them you noticed?
prompt.hi: आज किसने आपको कुछ सिखाया, और क्या आपने उन्हें यह जताया कि आपने ध्यान दिया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XLIV, Sanatsujatiya ("Bearing in mind the good he does, one should never do him any injury")

prompt.en: Was there a task today you considered beneath you?
prompt.hi: आज कोई कार्य था जिसे आपने अपने से तुच्छ माना?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XLIV, Sanatsujatiya ("He must not consider any service as mean, and must not harbour anger")

prompt.en: Did you speak ill of someone today, even if what you said was true?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आपने किसी की बुराई की, भले ही आपने जो कहा वह सत्य था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XLV, Sanatsujatiya ("True or false, it is not laudable to speak ill of others; they that do this have hell for their abode")

prompt.en: Did today's ups and downs actually reach you, or did some part of you stay untouched by both?
prompt.hi: आज के उतार-चढ़ाव वास्तव में आप तक पहुँचे, या आपका कोई अंश दोनों से अछूता रहा?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XLVI, Sanatsujatiya ("This transitory organism can never make me liable to joy and grief and the other attributes inhering to it")

prompt.en: Whose grief today would have troubled you less if you'd seen yourself in them?
prompt.hi: आज किसका दुख आपको कम विचलित करता, यदि आप उसमें स्वयं को देख पाते?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Udyoga Parva, Section XLVI, Sanatsujatiya ("He that beholdeth his own Self in everything, hath no longer to grieve")

prompt.en: What occupied your mind most today -- and is that where you actually want to be headed?
prompt.hi: आज आपके मन में सबसे अधिक क्या रहा — और क्या वही दिशा है जिधर आप वास्तव में जाना चाहते हैं?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 8.6 ("Whatever state of being one remembers when he quits his body, that state he will attain without fail")

prompt.en: Did you manage to hold onto what matters to you while still doing what the day demanded?
prompt.hi: आज जो आपके लिए मायने रखता है, क्या आप उसे थामे रख पाए जबकि दिन की माँगें भी पूरी कीं?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 8.7 ("Have Me, then, in thy heart always! and fight!")

prompt.en: Was there someone today whose worth you took for granted, simply because you know them well?
prompt.hi: आज कोई ऐसा था जिसका मूल्य आपने हल्के में लिया, केवल इसलिए कि आप उसे भली-भाँति जानते हैं?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 11.41-11.42 (Arjuna to Krishna: "Not knowing Your glories, and either because I was careless, or because I affectionately considered You as my friend, I have rashly addressed You")

prompt.en: What today did you meet as though it would last forever -- a mood, a trouble, a piece of luck?
prompt.hi: आज आपने किसे ऐसे लिया जैसे वह सदा रहेगा — कोई भाव, कोई कठिनाई, कोई सौभाग्य?

scripture_ref: Shanti Parva, Mokshadharma Parva, Section CCLXXXVII

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Mokshadharma Parva, Section CCLXXXVII (the sage Samanga: "all joys and sorrows also are not unending")

prompt.en: Did you let today's grief or joy become the whole of you, or could you stay yourself underneath either?
prompt.hi: क्या आज का शोक या हर्ष आपका संपूर्ण रूप बन गया, या आप दोनों के नीचे स्वयं बने रहे?

scripture_ref: Shanti Parva, Mokshadharma Parva, Section CCLXXXVI

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Mokshadharma Parva, Section CCLXXXVI ("One should live cheerfully, without yielding to either grief or joy. Such a man is said to be beyond the influence of pride")

prompt.en: Did every creature you crossed paths with today -- human or otherwise -- have reason to feel safe around you?
prompt.hi: आज आपके संपर्क में आया हर प्राणी — मनुष्य या अन्य — क्या आपके पास निर्भय अनुभव करने का कारण रखता था?

scripture_ref: Shanti Parva, Mokshadharma Parva, Section CCXLIV

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Mokshadharma Parva, Section CCXLIV ("To give abhaya to all creatures" -- a pledge to a life of total harmlessness, universal compassion and benevolence)

prompt.en: Something today went well because of you. How much of that credit is actually yours to claim?
prompt.hi: आज कुछ अच्छा हुआ जो आपके कारण था। उसका श्रेय वास्तव में कितना आपका है?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Section CCXXIV (Vali: "A person who thinks that it is he who slays another, is himself slain...both of them are ignorant of the truth")

prompt.en: Did you judge someone's action today by a rule that doesn't actually fit their circumstances?
prompt.hi: क्या आज आपने किसी के कार्य को ऐसे नियम से आँका जो वास्तव में उनकी परिस्थिति पर लागू नहीं होता?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Section CCLX ("The duties of a person who is well off are of one kind. Those of a person who has fallen into distress are of another kind")

prompt.en: Did you treat a stranger today with the same regard you give a friend?
prompt.hi: क्या आज आपने किसी अजनबी को उतना ही महत्व दिया जितना आप किसी मित्र को देते हैं?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Section CXCII ("They cast an equal eye on foes and friends and neutrals or strangers")

prompt.en: Did any small creature today -- an insect, a plant, something easy to overlook -- get harmed by your carelessness rather than your intent?
prompt.hi: आज किसी छोटे प्राणी को — कीट, पौधा, कुछ आसानी से नजरअंदाज होने वाला — आपकी लापरवाही से हानि पहुँची, आपकी मंशा से नहीं?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Section CXCII ("They never injure, in thought, word, or deed, immobile things or creatures that are viviparous, or oviparous or born of filth, or called vegetables")

prompt.en: You've changed since this morning, the way the moon changes shape through the month. What in you is still recognizably the same?
prompt.hi: आज सुबह से अब तक आप बदले हैं, जैसे चंद्रमा माह भर आकार बदलता है। आपमें क्या अब भी पहचाना जा सकता है वही रहा?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Section CCIII ("The moon, when it shows itself after its disappearance on the fifteenth day of the dark fortnight, is regarded as the same luminary that had become invisible")

prompt.en: Did seeking someone else's good today end up serving your own, in a way you didn't expect going in?
prompt.hi: आज किसी और की भलाई चाहने से आपकी अपनी भलाई भी हुई, ऐसे ढंग से जो आपने आरंभ में नहीं सोचा था?

scripture_ref: Shanti Parva, Mokshadharma Parva, Section CCLXXIII

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Mokshadharma Parva, Section CCLXXIII ("Such a man, inasmuch as he seeks the good of others, succeeds in winning good for himself")

prompt.en: Whom did you owe something today, not in money but in a good turn -- and did you pay it?
prompt.hi: आज आप किसके ऋणी थे, धन में नहीं बल्कि किसी भलाई में — और क्या आपने वह चुकाया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Section CCXCIII ("One pays off one's debt to one's fellowmen by doing good offices to them")

prompt.en: Did you avoid a responsibility today by dressing the avoidance up as a virtue?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आपने किसी उत्तरदायित्व से बचने को गुण का रूप देकर टाल दिया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Section X ("He who is competent to support life by prowess...does not live, but really falls away from his duty, by the hypocritical externals of a life of renunciation")

prompt.en: Before you tried to change anyone or anything else today, did you first look at what needed changing in yourself?
prompt.hi: आज किसी और को या किसी बात को बदलने से पहले, क्या आपने पहले स्वयं में देखा कि क्या बदलना है?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Section LXIX ("The king should first subdue himself and then seek to subdue his foes")

prompt.en: What today made your attention flicker like a flame in wind, and what would it have taken to shelter it?
prompt.hi: आज किस बात ने आपका ध्यान वायु में दीपक की भाँति काँपने दिया, और उसे बचाने के लिए क्या चाहिए था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 6.19 ("Just as a lamp in a windless place does not flicker, so the disciplined mind of a yogi remains steady in meditation")

prompt.en: Something today was excellent -- a skill, an act of kindness, a piece of work. Whose was it really, once you trace it back far enough?
prompt.hi: आज कुछ उत्कृष्ट था — कोई कौशल, कोई भलाई, कोई कार्य। पर्याप्त पीछे खोजने पर वह वास्तव में किसका था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 10.41 ("wheresoe'er is wondrous work, and majesty, and might, from Me hath all proceeded")

prompt.en: Today, did you act as though you were the body and its troubles, or as though you were the one aware of them?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आपने स्वयं को शरीर और उसकी परेशानियाँ मानकर व्यवहार किया, या उन्हें जानने वाले के रूप में?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 13.2 ("This body is called the field, and one who knows this field is called the knower of the field")

prompt.en: How much of today's turmoil was actually out there, and how much was unrest in your own mind?
prompt.hi: आज की उथल-पुथल में कितना वास्तव में बाहर था, और कितना आपके अपने मन की अशांति?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 17.16 ("Serenity of thought, gentleness, silence, self-control, and purity of purpose -- all these are declared as austerity of the mind")

prompt.en: Was your body's discipline today -- what you ate, how you moved, what you touched or avoided -- in service of anything beyond itself?
prompt.hi: आज आपके शरीर का अनुशासन — भोजन, गति, स्पर्श या परिहार — क्या स्वयं से बढ़कर किसी उद्देश्य की सेवा में था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 17.14 ("Worship of the gods, the twice-born, the teachers and the wise, purity, straightforwardness, celibacy and non-injury are called the austerities of the body")

prompt.en: Did you answer someone today before actually thinking the answer through?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आपने किसी को उत्तर देने से पहले वास्तव में विचार नहीं किया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Anusasana Parva, Section X ("Solicited by others, one should say only what is correct after settling it with the aid of reflection")

prompt.en: Did you stay content with what you already have today, or did wanting more pull at you?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आप जो पास है उसी में संतुष्ट रहे, या अधिक पाने की चाह ने आपको खींचा?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Anusasana Parva, Section XX ("I shall never swerve from that restraint which I have over desire and the other passions or from contentment with what I have already got")

prompt.en: Was there someone today who wronged you, or whom you disliked, that you could still meet without ill will?
prompt.hi: आज कोई ऐसा था जिसने आपके साथ अन्याय किया, या जिसे आप नापसंद करते हैं — क्या आप फिर भी बिना द्वेष के मिल सके?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 12.13-12.14 ("free from malice toward all living beings, who are friendly, and compassionate...ever-forgiving")

prompt.en: Did you speak about someone who wasn't there today in a way you'd be uncomfortable saying to their face?
prompt.hi: आज आपने किसी अनुपस्थित व्यक्ति के बारे में ऐसा कुछ कहा जो आप उनके सामने कहने में असहज होते?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 16.2 (divine qualities include "abstinence from slandering of others")

prompt.en: Is there a decision today you made quickly that deserved more reflection before you acted on it?
prompt.hi: आज कोई ऐसा निर्णय था जो आपने शीघ्रता से लिया, जबकि कार्य करने से पहले अधिक विचार आवश्यक था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 18.63 ("Thus, the path of wisdom...has been expounded to you by Me; comprehend it fully and then act as you wish")

prompt.en: Someone today was dear to you. What is it in you, not in them, that made them dear?
prompt.hi: आज कोई आपको प्रिय था। आपमें ऐसा क्या है, उनमें नहीं, जिसने उन्हें प्रिय बनाया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Brihadaranyaka Upanishad 2.4.5 (Yajnavalkya to Maitreyi: "Not for the sake of the husband, is the husband dear; but for the sake of the Self is the husband dear")

prompt.en: If everything you gained today were yours to keep forever, would it actually be worth having?
prompt.hi: यदि आज जो कुछ आपने पाया वह सदा के लिए आपका रहे, तो क्या वह वास्तव में पाने योग्य है?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Brihadaranyaka Upanishad 2.4.2-2.4.3 (Maitreyi asks if wealth could make her immortal; Yajnavalkya: "Of immortality, however, there is no hope through wealth")

prompt.en: Did you treat today's guest, teacher, or elder with the same regard this text asks you to give a god?
prompt.hi: आज आपने अतिथि, गुरु या बड़े का सत्कार वैसा किया जैसा यह ग्रंथ देवता के प्रति करने को कहता है?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Taittiriya Upanishad 1.11.2 ("Let thy mother be to thee like unto a god! Let thy father be to thee like unto a god!...Let thy guest be to thee like unto a god!")

prompt.en: What you ate today came from somewhere, and will one day return to somewhere. Did you treat it as ordinary, or as the sacred thing this text says it is?
prompt.hi: आज आपने जो खाया वह कहीं से आया, और एक दिन कहीं लौट जाएगा। क्या आपने उसे साधारण माना, या उस पवित्र वस्तु के रूप में जैसा यह ग्रंथ कहता है?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Taittiriya Upanishad 3.2 ("Food is Brahman... it is from food that all these beings are born; by food, when born, do they live, and having departed, into food they enter")

prompt.en: Was there something today you started too early, or too late -- and could you tell the difference before it was over?
prompt.hi: आज कोई ऐसा कार्य था जिसे आपने बहुत जल्दी या बहुत देर से आरंभ किया — और क्या आप इसका अंतर समाप्त होने से पहले जान सके?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: Shanti Parva, Section CXXXVIII ("When an act is begun at an improper time, it never becomes profitable when accomplished. That act, on the other hand, which is begun at the proper time, always produces splendid fruits")

prompt.en: In what way did you approach the day today -- with fear, with duty, with love, with indifference? Did the day answer you in kind?
prompt.hi: आज आपने दिन का सामना किस भाव से किया — भय, कर्तव्य, प्रेम, या उदासीनता से? क्या दिन ने आपको उसी भाव में उत्तर दिया?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 4.11 ("In whatever way men approach Me, even so do I reward them")

prompt.en: Did you today act as a friend to those you had no particular reason to be kind to?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आप उनके प्रति मित्रवत रहे जिनके साथ आपके पास दयालु होने का कोई विशेष कारण नहीं था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 5.29 ("Knowing Me...as the Friend of every being, he attains peace")

prompt.en: What today did you spend energy worrying about keeping or getting, that you could have simply trusted to work itself out?
prompt.hi: आज आपने किसे पाने या बनाए रखने की चिंता में ऊर्जा खर्च की, जिसे आप बस विश्वास कर सकते थे कि सुलझ जाएगा?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 9.22 ("To them, whose minds are always absorbed in Me, I provide what they lack and preserve what they already possess")

prompt.en: How many desires flowed into you today, and how much did your peace actually move?
prompt.hi: आज कितनी इच्छाएँ आप में प्रवाहित हुईं, और आपकी शांति वास्तव में कितनी डगमगाई?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 2.70 ("A person who is not disturbed by the incessant flow of desires -- that enter like rivers into the ocean, which is ever being filled but is always still -- can alone achieve peace")

prompt.en: Was there a moment today you were content simply being yourself, wanting nothing added?
prompt.hi: आज कोई क्षण था जब आप केवल स्वयं होने में संतुष्ट थे, कुछ भी और नहीं चाहते थे?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 2.55 ("When a man completely casts off all the desires of the mind, and is satisfied in the Self by the Self, then is he said to be one of steady Wisdom")

prompt.en: Was someone watching how you did something today and quietly taking it as the standard?
prompt.hi: आज क्या कोई आपको देख रहा था और चुपचाप आपके ढंग को मानदंड मान रहा था?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 3.21 ("Whatever action a great man performs, common men follow. And whatever standards he sets by exemplary acts, all the world pursues")

prompt.en: Something you did today felt like your own doing. How much of it was actually your mood, your habits, your circumstances doing it through you?
prompt.hi: आज का कोई कार्य आपको अपना किया हुआ लगा। उसमें कितना वास्तव में आपकी मनःस्थिति, आदतें, परिस्थितियाँ थीं जो आपके माध्यम से हुआ?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 3.27 ("All actions are wrought in all cases by the qualities of Nature alone. He whose mind is deluded by egoism thinks, 'I am the doer'")

prompt.en: Whose joy or sorrow today did you respond to as though it were actually your own?
prompt.hi: आज किसके सुख या दुख पर आपने ऐसे उत्तर दिया मानो वह वास्तव में आपका अपना हो?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 6.32 ("I regard them to be perfect yogis who see the true equality of all living beings and respond to the joys and sorrows of others as if they were their own")

prompt.en: A pleasure today started and ended within minutes. Did you notice that while it was happening, or only after?
prompt.hi: आज कोई सुख कुछ ही क्षणों में आरंभ होकर समाप्त हो गया। क्या आपने यह उसके घटित होते समय जाना, या केवल बाद में?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 5.22 ("Such pleasures have a beginning and an end, and so the wise man does not delight in them")

prompt.en: Did you actually strive for anything today, or only wish you had?
prompt.hi: आज क्या आपने वास्तव में किसी बात के लिए प्रयास किया, या केवल यह चाहा कि किया होता?

sources.source_chapter_or_section: 7.3 ("Out of many thousands among men, one may endeavor for perfection")
